study type: prospective descriptive study of incident reports
cohort: This study included 62,120 patients who underwent spinal anesthesia in 22 hospitals in Thailand between January and December of 2015.
finding: The incidence of cardiac arrest after spinal anesthesia was 1.13:10,000, and other complications included bradycardia (50.4%), anaphylaxis or drug allergy (14.2%), drug error (8.4%), and coma/CVA/convulsion (3.9%).
